# ex: compositeLitNeedsParen - composite literal in parenthesized if condition
ex {
	type T struct{ X int }
	T{1} -> T{2}
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F() {
	_ = (T{1}).X
	if (T{1}).X > 0 {
	}
	for (T{1}).X > 0 {
	}
	switch (T{1}).X {
	}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,11 +3,11 @@
 type T struct{ X int }

 func F() {
-	_ = (T{1}).X
-	if (T{1}).X > 0 {
+	_ = (T{2}).X
+	if (T{2}).X > 0 {
 	}
-	for (T{1}).X > 0 {
+	for (T{2}).X > 0 {
 	}
-	switch (T{1}).X {
+	switch (T{2}).X {
 	}
 }
